summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks ref against stored term URIs with node-type-aware equality (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Also changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to dir(self.uri). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering Namespace prefix positive/negative, SH, RDFS closed positive/negative/plain-string/Literal, and RDF closed positive plus RDF._1 negative. Tests were not run because the instructions prohibited running repository code; nothing was committed.
